AZURE_TENANT_ID.description: Which directory. Azure states no sensitivity for it, and it is one of the three values that together authenticate, so it is kept with them.

AZURE_CLIENT_ID.description: The app registration. Azure never says this may be published, so it is not treated as public here.

AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: One of two ways to prove the app registration. Azure shows the value once. Add a new secret before removing the old; there is no editing one in place.

AZURE_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PATH.description: The other way: a path to a certificate and private key in PEM or PFX. Set this or the secret above, not both.

AZURE_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD.description: Protects that file, when it is a PFX.
